description: Shows what one agent has spent today and this month, across every vendor it uses: model providers, HTTP APIs and on-chain payments in one figure. Free, and needs no account if you already have a deployment id. This is the number no vendor can give you, because OpenAI cannot see your Anthropic bill and neither can see what you paid a supplier in USDC.

deployment.description: The deployment id to report on. Defaults to you, if you are a registered deployment.

name: budget_status
